name: Update test calendar event
description: test-user-01 updates the subject of a previously created test calendar event. The update is reversible and intended to demonstrate a write-then-update lifecycle for observability correlation.
correlation_strategy: Updated subject retains the scenario-correlation token and appends a 'updated' marker.
notes: Only modifies the subject of an event created by SCN-CALENDAR-001. Does not modify other users' events.
